I’m Raka Muhammad Sixmarch, a 2026 Informatics graduate of Telkom University Surabaya. I enjoy understanding how things work and turning what I learn into practical projects—from exploring data and building dashboards to developing web applications and working with computer vision models.

My interests span AI engineering, machine learning, data analysis, web development, and cloud computing. Through my internship and projects, I’ve gained hands-on experience with data processing, visualization, and application development. I’m continuing to build on that foundation while exploring how these fields connect.

I welcome opportunities to contribute, collaborate, and keep growing—both in these areas and in new fields where I can develop useful skills.
